rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for speaking frankly or introducing an honest opinion.

example.english: Frankly, I think this plan is pretty solid.
example.traditional: 老實講，我覺得呢個計劃幾穩陣。
example.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 gok3 dak1 ne1 go3 gai3 waak6 gei2 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Use this especially when stressing that what follows is the truth, rather than mainly its blunt delivery.

example.english: Frankly, the food at this restaurant is really good.
example.traditional: 講真，呢間餐廳啲嘢真係幾好食。
example.jyutping: gong2 zan1 ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 zan1 hai6 gei2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this when deliberately speaking directly or bluntly, especially before criticism or an unwelcome point.

example.english: Frankly, your report still isn't finished.
example.traditional: 直講啦，你份報告仲未做好。
example.jyutping: zik6 gong2 laa1 nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung6 mei6 zou6 hou2
